name: io.github.evvfebruary/kaiten-mcp
title: Kaiten
description: Manage Kaiten spaces, boards, cards, comments, and tags with compact MCP responses.

environmentVariables.name: KAITEN_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Kaiten API token from Profile > API key.

environmentVariables.name: KAITEN_WORKSPACE_SLUG
environmentVariables.description: Kaiten workspace slug. Required unless KAITEN_BASE_URL is set.

environmentVariables.name: KAITEN_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Full Kaiten API root for on-prem or custom domains. Required unless KAITEN_WORKSPACE_SLUG is set.
